prompts.harbor:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: original raster environment background for cinematic first-person browser history adventure Crown & Current, Chapter 4 Rule Britannia, 1660–1763. Style/medium: painterly semi-realistic AAA historical adventure environment, grounded and richly detailed, invented illustrative scene rather than documentary. Wide landscape composition, 16:9 or wider. First-person eye-level viewpoint, atmospheric dark navy shadows, deep teal hues and warm amber lamplight. Scene: colonial Boston wharf c.1733 in evening sea mist. Wooden crates and barrels in foreground, rigged merchant vessels and masts on left, wharf path and weathered timber buildings on right. Strong central depth along the wooden wharf, warm period oil lamps glowing through mist. Historical materials and rigging, damp timber textures, softly receding ships and structures.
